answer.report_md:
**画出来要什么**

需绘制单面板横向分组条形图：14个长类别、2024与2022两系列、共28条；百分比标签置于条内，图例在绘图区右下，类别分成三个无标题区段。标题须拆分图号、主标题、副标题，并保留图框与来源行。

**定位一个值难在哪**

“71”出现两次：2022年的“There is a sitemap (or index)”和2024年的“Businesses can access their own data online”。唯一定位必须同时保留完整类别和年份。

**不确定的**

题目未说明目标“71”指哪一处；spot check按2024年企业访问自身数据的条形记录。百分比单位仅见于刻度和数值标签，没有独立轴标题。

heading.title: Number of Member States with portals incorporating the assessed technology features,
heading.subtitle: 2022 and 2024

key: Businesses can access their own data online
worked_example.why_hard: 71% also labels another category; category and year are both required.

components.evidence: Blue 2024 and yellow 2022 bars appear side by side for each category.
Category labels are left of bars growing horizontally toward 100%.
“Sources: 2022 and 2024 United Nations E-Government Surveys.” appears below the figure.
The “2024” and “2022” legend is inside the lower-right plot area.
Percentages including “91%”, “83%” and “27%” are printed inside their bars.
“Specific service transactions initiated through the portal can be saved and accessed later” wraps onto two lines.
